stopping_rule: One execution opportunity per registered slot, timeout120 seconds, maximum144 full-profile notebook opportunities. Record ordinary slot failure and continue all other planned slots without retry/replacement. Interruptions retain planned/registered/running slots as noncompleted; output directories cannot be resumed or overwritten.
evaluation_semantics: Independent contexts from the same context distribution; exact conditional intervention means on a finite grid, plus independent realized potential outcomes. Intermediate evaluation prices are absent from training; endpoints are shared. No price-domain extrapolation or new-family generalization claim; fresh x may exceed the finite training x range.
uncertainty: Across the 12 independent family-specific world/data draws, report mean, sample SD, MCSE, and empirical quantiles; paired differences share each campaign. No row-level independence, confidence interval, p-value, or universal superiority claim.
ridge_objective: sum squared residuals + 0.01 * sum(non-intercept coefficients squared)
summary_levels: Per-family baseline distributions and paired left-minus-right differences across campaign seeds, with planned/completed denominators. Quantiles use h=(n-1)*q linear interpolation. No pooled headline. MCSE=sample SD/sqrt(n), unavailable if n<2. Available-case summaries explicitly labeled.
subset_metrics: Owner-side seen_price_rmse and unseen_price_rmse: RMSE of predicted versus oracle mean over all context-action rows with price respectively in or outside the five training price support points.
generator_specification: generate.py is normative; family/seed/component SHA256-derived independent PRNG streams, no rejection or outcome-based selection.
